title: •IG-88
caption: •IG-88 (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. May use two weapons. Once per turn, if escorting a captive, may take any one card from Force Pile into hand; reshuffle. May lose 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting IG-88. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Bounty hunter. Went berserk upon activation. Murdered all designers at Holowan Mechanicals. IG-88’s outstanding “dismantle on sight” warrant ignored by Darth Vader.

notes: Unique. {pilot:2} at the start (stub omits it). Stats POWER 4 / ARMOR 5 and a wide third box ASSASSIN DROID (label only). Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow DS helmet), one tall blue box holding TWO warrior icons (listed as warrior, warrior), then a red square with a white figure = Decipher's printed Presence icon (GEMP lists Pilot, Warrior x2, Presence for IG-88 (V); the printed card has no Presence). Droid. The wiki's default 'IG-88' page carries Glossary 2.0 wording; printed face = 'IG-88 (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Dagobah-D-ig88.gif is the PC Errata face (bold 'Bounty hunter') — downloaded to src/vs5/40-Dagobah-D-ig88.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes around “dismantle on sight” (wiki single quotes), curly apostrophe in IG-88’s. Copyright 'TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.' read off the 745 px face. Modern: V0-D-ig88.gif (745 px); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
